verses.text: A prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

segments.text: A prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

verses.text: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.

segments.text: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.

verses.text: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.

segments.text: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.

verses.text: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

segments.text: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

verses.text: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.

segments.text: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.

verses.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.

segments.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.

verses.text: In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.

segments.text: In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.

verses.text: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.

segments.text: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.

verses.text: All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.

segments.text: All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.

verses.text: For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.

segments.text: For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.

verses.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.

segments.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.

verses.text: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.

segments.text: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.

verses.text: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.

segments.text: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.

verses.text: The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life; they have no regard for You.

segments.text: The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life; they have no regard for You.

verses.text: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.

segments.text: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.

verses.text: Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.

segments.text: Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.

verses.text: Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
